questions.question: Describe the process you led to deduplicate COVID-19 reinfection data. How did you gather requirements from counties, define the data rules, and validate the resulting dataset?

In your Hawaii Department of Health role, you helped transition an entire division to a new database system. What was your role in documenting current processes, identifying data requirements, managing change, and training users?

This role requires detailed requirements gathering and creation of user stories and acceptance criteria. Can you walk through how you would convert a stakeholder request for a logistics or transportation dashboard into clear requirements for a technical team?

You have worked with fiscal data, Medicaid claims, demographic data, and surveillance data. How did you reconcile differences in definitions, identifiers, data quality, and reporting needs across multiple source systems?
Tell me about a data-quality policy or standard you recommended at the Hawaii Department of Health. What issue did it address, how did you gain stakeholder agreement, and what was the outcome?

The position involves UAT planning, test-script development, execution, and status reporting. Based on your experience with new database implementation or surveillance-data processes, how have you tested a new workflow or data output before it was put into use?

Describe your work allocating PPE across hundreds of providers during the COVID-19 response. How did you analyze demand versus available inventory, prioritize allocations, and communicate decisions to stakeholders?

How have you used SQL, SAS, R, Excel, or Access to create repeatable reporting processes? Please give an example where you combined multiple datasets, created a reliable data structure, and delivered actionable reporting.

This role requires facilitating requirement-discovery workshops with business and technical stakeholders. What approach would you take to lead a workshop involving operations users, product managers, engineers, and external clients with differing priorities?

What is your understanding of transportation management systems and logistics processes such as order management, load planning, shipment execution, tendering, visibility, freight audit, and fleet management, and how would you quickly build domain knowledge for this role?
